title: Single-cell RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics characterize CD8exhausted T cells in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
snippet: Pancreatic cancer resists immunotherapy due to a suppressive immune microenvironment where CD8T cells play a key role. Using single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics, we characterized CD8exhausted T (Tex) cells in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC).
